purpose: Matched short experiment testing whether an actionable signed-distance renderer improves boundary sharpness without moving the boundary center, relative to an image-residual output with identical data, backbone, heads, initialization and update schedule.

final_decision.reason: After clean supersampled labels, 1800 matched steps, held-out shapes, convergence checks, fixed source blending and residual-to-renderer blending, the renderer improved edge width and halo but did not preserve boundary center, contour distance, identity behavior or exposure consistency together.

data.label_generation: Draw binary geometry, compute signed distance, render the continuous target at 4x resolution, then area-downsample both target and signed distance. No low-resolution distance transform is used.

training.convergence_extension_reason: The clean 600-step renderer was still improving and already reduced image MAE, so both matched arms are rerun from scratch for 1800 steps before any mechanism decision.

evaluation.selection: Renderer must show a consistent Pareto improvement in center/width/halo over the residual baseline; no single aggregate score can authorize a full R105.
